analysis: This PR changes only provider documentation. In hardware-requirements.md (head lines 3, 64-66), quickstart.md (head lines 3, 242-243) and troubleshooting.md (the new 'Missing base reward' section, a See-also link, and the date bump) it adds guidance that a green `doctor` and local billing rows do not prove a coordinator `model=base_reward` grant, and links to base-rewards.md. No code, protocol, key-handling, attestation, authorization, cache or fan-helper behavior changes, so TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009, TB-010 and TB-011 and their threats (T-041 etc.) are untouched. The new text is conservative: it does not claim authorization or trust from local diagnostics, which is consistent with T-052 (shadow or local evidence mistaken for serving permission) and T-058 (diagnostics misstating trust). It adds no secrets, endpoints or deployment claims. One coverage limit: the linked base-rewards.md is not in the supplied evidence. It is not shown as added by this PR, so a broken link is possible, but that is a doc-quality matter, not a security finding. The platform-owned coordinator behavior behind base rewards is out of scope and was not verified. No security regression identified.
